name: quantum-project
description: Unified single codebase for Quantum Dynamics (Next.js + Node.js Express)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix quantum-dynamics-backend" "npm run dev --prefix quantum-dynamics-frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix quantum-dynamics-backend && npm install --prefix quantum-dynamics-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --prefix quantum-dynamics-backend" "npm run start --prefix quantum-dynamics-frontend"
